exports.name: fused::validate_classified
exports.signature: pub fn validate_classified(bytes: &[u8], masks: &BlockMasks, state: &mut Utf8Stream) -> Result<()>
exports.behavior: Reject blocks above 64 bytes, mismatched valid_len, noncanonical valid_mask, high non_ascii_mask lanes, and incorrect actual byte high bits before mutating state. Accepted metadata delegates directly to stream::validate_chunk. Other classifications and backend tags are ignored.

test_vectors.coverage: Lengths 0 through 64 at offsets 0 through 63, ASCII controls and DEL, invalid surrounding bytes, and exact summaries.
Every u8 valid_len for each actual length, every single-bit mutation in valid_mask and non_ascii_mask, full state preservation with pending UTF-8 and scanner carry, and successful retry.
Actual lengths 65, 127, 128, 255, 256, and 257 with multiple forged declared lengths and recovery after rejection.
An invalid byte at each of 64 lanes, including bit 63; forged ASCII returns nonpoisoning InvalidToken, while truthful classification returns transactional InvalidUtf8 with an absolute offset.
All 256 backend tags, all unrelated mask fields set to u64::MAX, and empty, ASCII, valid multibyte, incomplete, and invalid inputs.
Pending, chunk-failed, finish-failed, and successfully finished streams; rejected metadata preserves every state field, accepted metadata matches stream behavior, and reset permits reuse.
Every incomplete prefix of two-, three-, and four-byte scalars; empty chunks preserve state, ASCII fails at the original leading byte, and failures remain sticky.
Completion of a carried four-byte scalar followed by malformed UTF-8 in the same block rolls back counters, ASCII status, and pending storage while saving the first error.
Alternating stream and fused calls complete four-, two-, and three-byte scalars with exact intermediate tail contents and final byte/scalar counts.

Every three-part split, including empty chunks, of scalar-range boundaries, noncharacters, BOM and combining text, overlong forms, surrogates, out-of-range scalars, bad continuations, illegal leaders, and truncations. Compares state and errors with stream, results with core UTF-8 validation, and successful summaries with validate and proof.
All 256 one-byte and 65536 two-byte inputs with split delivery and empty chunks.
Two-, three-, and four-byte scalars near 64- and 128-byte boundaries, eight alignments, splits inside scalars, terminal truncations, and mutated final continuation bytes.

Private-state fixtures model u32::MAX without oversized allocation. Exact-limit acceptance, metadata rejection before overflow, overflow before UTF-8 validation, sticky failure, and finished-state precedence are asserted.
Pending four-byte scalar near u32::MAX, truncation and malformed continuation offsets, cumulative overflow precedence, and exact-limit completion.
